message: So, the other day I realized I have three smoke alarms in my tiny apartment—yes, three! 😅 I might be a bit on the gloriously over-prepared side, but hey, it gives me peace of mind. I even have a kitchen escape plan taped to the fridge, just in case my cooking experiments go awry. It’s all about staying ready without the stress, right? What little things do you do to feel prepared at home?
